semantic.justification: Original constructor/destructor temporarily select and restore the actual document HTML_MODE setting for native pool-style defaults. Connected native HTMLParser tokens to actual Writer document/cursor, original HTMLAttrTable heads, HTMLAttrContext token search/removal and deferred attribute ownership. Consumed body/paragraph/division/center, heading, quotation/address/preformatted modes, text/entity/space handling, three-script bold/posture, strike/underline aliases and native80percent super/sub attributes retain original property defaults and queue ordering. AppendTextNode uses native script services and clone/previous-list precedence. Markdown supplies a blank paragraph at section EOF; the consumed empty-tail cleanup preserves real node/cursor owners. SwReader/SfxHTMLParser desktop/media orchestration and arbitrary mid-paragraph standalone HTML insertion are not ported or certified. Full CSS/named-semantic-character/font/link/list/table producers remain concrete HTML filter work. No DOM or clipboard conversion is used. Source-backed actual-model tests only; compiled desktop differential and whole-module parity remain unverified.
